title: Virtual Plein Air Watercolor Experience
author: SofydollDesigns
description:
Plein Air (a french term for outdoor painting) is the art of painting the scenery around you, on site. It’s a relaxing way to spend some time outdoors. The beauty of the iPad is that you can take it anywhere, whether inside or outside. However, some days it’s just not possible yet you still want to have the experience. The Virtual Plein Air Watercolor Experience is a neat way to do that.
This set is offers a customizable simulated plein air experience with a mini color palette, reference image area and is available with both beachy and woodsy backgrounds…depending on your mood.
I’ve also included a fully layered Procreate practice template so you can work on your own technique using the included brushes. Be sure to watch the video to see the set in action.
Simply pop in your headphones, listen to some soothing beach sounds (or sounds of the forrest) and paint away!
Included in this set.
46 Brushes
Procreate Plein Air Simulator w/ Customizable Elements
1 Canvas Texture
1 Procreate Practice Template
There are now 2 versions of the Plein Air Canvas:
Larger 5000 x 4000 pixels -Smaller 3300 x 2550 pixels
